description: Set bank credit growth range at 7.5-10.5% associated with the monetary aggregate targets
justification: The range allows substantial credit growth but within defined limits, representing a balanced approach between growth and constraint.

description: Adjusted the equivalent M-1 growth range to 3-6% to account for the dampening effect of ATS and NOW account expansion
justification: While the adjustment is slightly more accommodative than the original range, it still constrains money growth for anti-inflationary purposes.

description: Established money supply growth targets for M-1, M-2, and M-3 from Q4 1978 to Q4 1979 within ranges of 1.5-4.5%, 5-8%, and 6-9% respectively to resist inflationary pressures while encouraging moderate economic expansion
justification: The targets constrain monetary growth to resist inflationary pressures, representing a moderately restrictive stance designed to combat inflation.

description: Implemented new reserve requirements of 8% on a basket of managed liabilities including CDs, federal funds, repurchase agreements, and Eurodollar takings
justification: The new reserve requirements increase banking costs and restrict credit creation, representing moderately restrictive policy.

description: Increased the discount rate by 1 percentage point to 12%
justification: The discount rate increase to 12% represents a significant tightening of monetary policy conditions.

description: Set federal funds rate range at 11.5-15.5% with provision for supplementary instructions if operations would maintain the rate near the upper limit
justification: The federal funds rate range of 11.5-15.5% represents very tight monetary conditions and strongly restrictive policy.

description: Changed operating procedures to focus on reserve aggregates rather than federal funds rate targeting to better achieve money supply targets
justification: The procedural change is designed to better control monetary aggregates and resist inflation, representing a moderately restrictive approach.

description: Directed restraint of reserve aggregate expansion to achieve deceleration in monetary aggregate growth in Q4 1979 to keep full-year growth within target ranges
justification: The decision explicitly restrains reserve growth to decelerate monetary aggregates, representing a moderately restrictive policy stance.

description: Provided forward guidance that growth ranges for 1980 may be within the same ranges as 1979, depending on economic conditions
justification: The guidance suggests continuation of the restrictive monetary framework into 1980 to maintain anti-inflationary pressure.
